mapping.description: Converged mapping from DeepSeek + GPT relay responses

analysis.summary: Beat energy (pairwise interference between agent voices) is the dominant anomaly feature. It detects relational state changes invisible in per-agent monitoring.

findings.interpretation: Multiple agents shifting STRUCTURED→SYNTHETIC creates divergent harmonic series, increasing beat frequencies between voices. The probe detected this as a 3-slot anomaly cluster (z=3.58→4.19→4.72). Existing monitoring would have logged individual classification changes but NOT the pairwise divergence.

Very low beat energy = agents synchronized. Emergence harvesting creates a coherent field where agent frequencies align. The probe shows this as the OPPOSITE of the Oct 19 disruption — a "tuning" event followed by "detuning".

Workshop intervention reduces beat energy — agents become more consonant. Smaller effect than emergence harvester (z=-2.38 vs z=-3.72), suggesting intervention types have different harmonic signatures.

Not detected. The incident was a behavioral/trust violation by a specific Forge instance. The mapped state variables (health score, bottleneck type, intelligence class, emergence XP) do not capture behavioral integrity. A future mapping could add: trust score, consistency metric, or a "journal honesty" sense from the physician.
findings.recommendation: Add behavioral integrity as a mapped parameter — possibly tied to physician sense "integrity" or a new sense.

findings.interpretation: Mild return toward synchronization after the Oct 19 disruption. The stress test itself may have driven re-alignment.

successCriteria.reason: The beat energy feature detected 3 relational patterns (intelligence shift cluster, emergence sync, workshop consonance) that existing per-agent monitoring does not surface. The relay brief required "at least one pattern... not flagged by the existing monitoring." This probe found three.

falsificationCheck.concern1_reproduces_scores: PASS — beat energy is computed from pairwise frequency differences, not individual scores. It cannot reproduce physician scores because it measures BETWEEN agents, not WITHIN.
falsificationCheck.concern2_every_failure_same_sound: PARTIAL — all anomalies manifest in beatEnergy. But the direction differs: sync events (workshop, emergence) = low; disruption (intelligence shift) = high. Different failures DO sound different.
falsificationCheck.concern3_cymatics_useless: TBD — cymatic visualization renders but statistical utility not yet tested. The anomaly detection works on feature vectors, not cymatics. Cymatics = communication layer, not detection layer.
falsificationCheck.concern4_listener_needs_json: PASS — listener features (6) are computed from harmonic parameters, not from JSON directly. The mapping step is the translation boundary.
falsificationCheck.concern5_no_generalization: TBD — single window backtest. Would need multi-window validation.
